note: Unbaked. Dialogue lines in scene order, then the PULL UP A CHAIR battle lines (kind praise, keyed by speaker id). Deedee, Boppy, TNB and the rest use their existing voices. HUSH-9 speaks in its chapter 13 voice. Nara never speaks, so her narration lines are left out.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Eight chairs. Deedee, there are seven of us and a dog.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Nara counts. Nara is people. Sit, sit, sit. Everybody sit.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: This is the first time all of us have been at one table. I’m going to film it. For the memories.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Phone down. Eat first. Film after.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Eating is also content.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: TNB, sweetheart. Look at you. You’re too thin. Is Tommy feeding you? Tommy, are you feeding him?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: He makes the bowls I eat out of. We’re even.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: It’s a very good bowl, Deedee. I’m biased.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Polite, and he makes bowls. Tommy. Keep this one.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That’s the plan.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Nara, honey. Come here. Crust, from the very edge of the pie. That’s the best part. Don’t tell Tommy.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: Nara doesn’t eat from strangers. She ate from you.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: I’m not a stranger. I’m a woman with crust.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Nobody touch the peppers. Those came off the plant by the window. They are not for the faint of heart.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: TNB. You work in a fancy restaurant. You eat anything?

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Mostly I serve it.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: That’s a no.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: That’s a “professionally, I’m very polite about it.”

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: One pepper each. You and me. First one to reach for water loses.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: I’ll time it. Nobody move. Nobody breathe. Ready? Go.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: Is somebody going to die?

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Rose. Not in front of the pepper.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: It’s nothing. It’s fine. It’s... it’s fine.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: It’s actually quite floral. There’s a bright citrus note at the front.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: ...Citrus.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Dad, you’re sweating.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: It’s warm in here. It’s the oven. Deedee, what is the oven doing?

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Nothing. It’s off. Robert.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Forty seconds. Boppy’s hand is moving toward the water. It is hovering. It is hovering.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: My stomach is doing something.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: That’s the pepper!

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: It was doing something BEFORE.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I’m calling it a draw. Neither of us reached. I’m going to breathe through my nose for a minute. I can’t feel my face. Nobody say anything.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: ...You’ll do.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: That’s the nod. Tommy. Your father gave him the nod.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I know what the nod is. I got it after the third visit.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Okay. Toast. Everybody up. Glasses. Nara, paw.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: To the table.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: To the eight chairs!

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: To the CRUST!

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: To the moon and back.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The laughing stops. Nobody stops it. The sound just goes. Rose’s mouth is open and nothing is coming out.

lines.speaker: HUSH-9
lines.text: THIS IS A QUIET CAR.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It’s a dining room.

lines.speaker: HUSH-9
lines.text: It is the loudest dining room I have ever measured. Forty-one decibels of laughing. Mr. Vance does not want laughing. Laughing is how people leak.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: It’s a family dinner. Everybody gets to be loud at a family dinner.

lines.speaker: HUSH-9
lines.text: That is the problem. You are happiest here. I have been upgraded. I am quiet in all directions. FINAL FORM.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Nobody gets past us. Nobody comes to this table and shushes my wife’s cooking.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Robert. Your back.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: I’ll do it with my back.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Dad, sit. We’re rotating. Amy’s up front with us. You’re on the bench. When somebody needs a break, wave, and tag in a friend.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: A bench call. We have a bench. I have been waiting my whole life to say bench call.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: Can I raspberry the train?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: You may raspberry the train.

lines.speaker: HUSH-9
lines.text: Shh. Again. Round two.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Slower. Chair or chatter. Tag in a friend if you need one.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Up, up. Eat something. Sit a minute. Then we try again.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The chip cracks right down the middle. HUSH-9 lowers its glove. For a moment the room is exactly as quiet as it wanted.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: Somebody’s laughing.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: It’s the TRAIN.

lines.speaker: HUSH-9
lines.text: I measured forty-one decibels. It was forty-one decibels of nobody leaving.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Scoot, Robert. The train needs a chair.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Why am I scooting?

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Because you’re the widest.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: My BACK is the widest.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Rhubarb crisp. Nine minutes. Eat.

lines.speaker: HUSH-9
lines.text: I do not eat.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: Everybody eats.

lines.speaker: HUSH-9
lines.text: ...It is warm. It is loud. It is... acceptable.

lines.speaker: HUSH-9
lines.text: The chip is broken. I cannot keep it quiet. I do not understand. It is very loud in here and nobody is sad.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: That’s the point of the loud.

lines.speaker: HUSH-9
lines.text: Mr. Vance asked me to deliver a message. “Thank you for dinner. Tomorrow, the Square. Bring everyone. I would like a family photograph.”

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: That’s not a photograph. That’s a trap.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Of course it’s a trap. We’ll bring everyone anyway. And we’ll bring dessert.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: I’m wearing the good scrunchie.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: It left its chip! It plays a tiny dinner! Listen!

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Deedee. Fifty-one years.

lines.speaker: Deedee
lines.text: And counting, Robert.

lines.speaker: Boppy
lines.text: Don’t make it weird.

battleLines.speaker: tom
battleLines.text: There’s a chair at the end of the table. It’s folding. It’s yours. Please sit down.

battleLines.speaker: tom
battleLines.text: You’ve been standing in the doorway of every room for years. Come in. We’ll shuffle over.

battleLines.speaker: grace
battleLines.text: Okay, so it’s a very small quiet car, and it’s my grandparents’ house, and you’re invited to dinner. Subscribe to dinner!

battleLines.speaker: grace
battleLines.text: You can sit next to me. I’ll only tell you to be quiet during my videos. That’s a rule for everybody.

battleLines.speaker: rose
battleLines.text: You can sit by Nara! Nara loves everybody! Nara already loves you!

battleLines.speaker: rose
battleLines.text: I made you a name tag. It says HUSH. I spelled the H very carefully.

battleLines.speaker: amy
battleLines.text: Dinner is at six. You’re not late. Late is when you don’t come. Sit.

battleLines.speaker: amy
battleLines.text: I have taught a room of thirty kids with a recorder each. You are not the loudest thing I have handled. Sit.

battleLines.speaker: deedee
battleLines.text: Sit, sit, you’re too thin. Even a train. Who wants rhubarb crisp? Everyone. Even the train.

battleLines.speaker: deedee
battleLines.text: Oh, honey. Nobody ever saved you a seat? Here. Right here next to me.

battleLines.speaker: boppy
battleLines.text: Sit down. Take the weight off. My back understands better than anybody.

battleLines.speaker: boppy
battleLines.text: Pull up a chair. I’ll tell you about my stomach. It’s loud, but you’ll live.

battleLines.speaker: tnb
battleLines.text: I set you a place. Fork on the left. I’m a server. It’s how I say hello.

battleLines.speaker: tnb
battleLines.text: Hey. I have a thermos. It’s very quiet cocoa. Sit with us a minute.
